title: DiQAD: A Benchmark Dataset for End-to-End Open-domain Dialogue Assessment
reasoning: The paper includes an "Ethics Statement" and discusses filtering toxic content and privacy in data collection. However, these are related to data hygiene and responsible AI practices for the dataset itself, rather than a component of evaluating or benchmarking the ethical or moral reasoning capabilities of dialogue systems or LLMs as a primary focus. The dialogue quality assessment criteria do not include dimensions directly related to religion, morals, or ethics beyond general user safety/privacy.
